name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. Uses direct FlixCloud MKV downloads, preserves both HD-2 mirrors, identifies shared SUB+DUB files as Dual Audio + Subs, preserves Season 0 coordinates, and shows an informational No Episode on Source result when Re:ANIME has a matching catalog record explicitly marked as not watchable.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME direct-download behavior

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: Production WCO provider with wcostream.tv → wcoflix.tv → wcoforever.net frontend fallback coverage, premium/mirror support, Episode 0 and fractional-special fallbacks, corrected audio classification, and the separately gated Power Rangers resolver. Anime requests now default to MAL/AniList-assisted identity resolution from Nuvio's TMDB/IMDb input, using English, romaji, native, and synonym titles before falling back to TMDB aliases. Non-anime titles keep the normal TMDB path, while strict series/episode ownership checks remain in place to block generic search matches and Recent Releases/sidebar contamination.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: AsiaFlix
scrapers.description: Experimental Asian drama/show provider using AsiaFlix's current v1 JSON API for title search, detail/episode lookup, and server resolution. Matches Nuvio TMDB/IMDb metadata against primary and alternate titles, preserves original-audio language labels, probes HLS quality where available, and intentionally refuses TV seasons above Season 1 until a safe season-title mapping is validated.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on current Yuzono/Keiyoushi AsiaFlix and CSX provider behavior

scrapers.name: Tubi
scrapers.description: Tubi playback provider using Tubi's current anonymous-device bearer-token flow, strict TMDB/IMDb title matching, nested season/episode mapping, and clear HLS playback. Keeps the top two video quality levels with up to two distinct manifests per quality (four rows max), preferring hlsv6 and H.264 within each quality, and safely skips DRM-only titles rather than exposing unusable Widevine streams.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus Tubi provider based on current Tubi public API behavior

scrapers.name: AnikotoTV
scrapers.description: AnikotoTV with standardized DUB/SOFTSUB/DUB+SUBS output labels based on the provider's existing selectable caption tracks.
scrapers.author: piratezoro9
